name: validate-handoff
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
p=Path.cwd();a=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text());r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());b=json.loads((p/'literal-bindings.json').read_text())
assert set(r)==set(map(str,a['ids'])) and len(b)==20
for x in b:
 raw=x['raw'].encode();o=json.loads(raw);assert o['mathdb_id']==x['id']
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256'] and raw.endswith(b'\n')
 assert json.loads(x['statement_token'])==o['statement']==x['decoded_statement']
 assert hashlib.sha256(x['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['token_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['decoded_sha256']
 assert r[str(x['id'])]['credit']==0 and len(r[str(x['id'])]['gates'])==9
assert (p/'original20.jsonl').read_text()==''.join(x['raw'] for x in b)
for n in ['ACTUALBRIEF.md','DERIVATIONS.md','DORMANT-SOL-FORMAL-PLAN.md','access-inventory.json','source-read-inventory.json','resource-inventory.json','registry-inventory.json']:assert (p/n).stat().st_size>0
print('PASS exact20 provenance/token/decoded bindings and nine separate gates; credit0; inventories present. No mathematical or formal test executed.')
